feedback: All test cases directly and unambiguously validate the requirement that operators of equal precedence (addition and subtraction) are evaluated left to right. Test R006-T01 correctly targets subtraction operators of equal precedence, ensuring left-to-right evaluation. Test R006-T03 directly validates addition and subtraction with left-to-right evaluation. Test R006-T02 is correctly excluded as it involves operators of different precedence (multiplication and addition), and thus does not test the left-to-right rule for equal-precedence operators. The test design accurately reflects the customer intent and the specified interface. Coverage is complete and justified by the requirement and examples.
